preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The input string t consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
The length of string t, n, is an integer between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).
The number of queries, q, is an integer between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in (l1, l2, length)) for (l1, l2, length) in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of three integers l1, l2, and length, where 1 ≤ l1, l2 ≤ n, 1 ≤ length ≤ n - max(l1, l2) + 1, and the substrings t[l1 ... l1 + length - 1] and t[l2 ... l2 + length - 1] are valid (i.e., do not exceed string bounds).

postconditions.expression: all((s1 == s2 or is_reachable(s1, s2)) == (output_line.strip().upper() == 'YES') for (l1, l2, length), output_line in zip(queries, output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is 'YES' if and only if the substring t[l1 ... l1 + length - 1] (denoted s1) is reachable from the substring t[l2 ... l2 + length - 1] (denoted s2), where reachability is defined by the existence of a sequence of operations transforming s2 into s1 using the allowed replacements ('011' ↔ '110').

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.strip()) == 2 and output_line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is exactly 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).
